Class EventQueueBuilderVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.cardsFolder.visitor.EventQueueBuilderVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
TribeVisitor
public class EventQueueBuilderVisitor extends Object implements TribeVisitor
Builds the ordered event queue from a player's event cards. Sustain events are placed last; all other event types are resolved first. Within each group, events are sorted by era.
